title: Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 41a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.41a.21), Rav Chiyya son of Rav Natan explicitly teaches Rav Chisda’s ruling. Hyman infers that he lived in Rava’s time. In [Menachot 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.39a.8), he transmits the teaching in this form: “Rav Huna said …”[^1]

notes.text: In the full Menachot passage, Rav Huna cites Rav Sheshet, who cites Rav Yirmeya bar Abba in Rav’s name. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1268&lang=en) on the question of his chronology.
